subject: Rate-card carveout request — NimbusHealth strategic commitment
messages:
From: Avery Connors <avery.connors@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up — strategic 3yr commitment (rate card request)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and routing controls. We're finalizing commercial assumptions for our vendor shortlist and have a couple of asks that could change which route we take. High level: NimbusHealth is evaluating a 3-year, high-commitment deployment for inference across multiple regions (US primary, EU DR). The deal is materially larger than our pilot.

Two asks from procurement:
- A one-time carveout on the standard rate card for committed reserved capacity (they want a blended per-token rate below our published Tier 1)
- Waiver of the packaging surcharge for the first 12 months if we sign a 36-month term

We're not asking for deep discounts if there's offsetting commitments (volume ramps, firm MRR). Can you put together the commercial shape you can offer (ballpark discount % by year and any packaging concessions)? Procurement would like a short memo they can take to their procurement committee by Oct 27.

I'm attaching the RFP response template — procurement will populate benchmarking after you send the numbers.

Appreciate it,

Avery
Director, Cloud Strategy
NimbusHealth

Attachments: Nimbus_RFP_Q4_2026.pdf
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Avery Connors <avery.connors@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — strategic 3yr commitment (rate card request)

Avery —

Thanks for the clear asks and the RFP. Quick initial read: this is strategically meaningful (multi-region, multi-year) and I think we can get to a commercial shape that keeps unit economics reasonable if we structure it as a reserved-capacity + host-based burst.

Draft commercial outline (ballpark — need internal signoff):
- Year 1 effective blended token rate: 60% of published Tier 1 (applies to reserved commit up to X tokens/month)
- Year 2: 70% of Tier 1
- Year 3: 75% of Tier 1
- Packaging surcharge: propose waiving the 12-month packaging surcharge if Nimbus commits to 36 months and provides a 120-day ramp schedule
- Minimum commitment: 18-month billing commitment with 36-month contract term (annual true-up)

This exceeds our delegated discount thresholds, so I need VP/CFO signoff for the initial carveout. Marissa / Marcus — looping you in to start the approval path. I'll draft a short exception memo and include cost-offset scenarios (quantization + batching assumptions) for finance.

Avery — I can have a concise memo + commercial summary for your procurement committee by Oct 24 (or Oct 26 at the latest). Does that work on your side?

Best,

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — strategic 3yr commitment (rate card request)

Rafael —

I reviewed the draft outline. High-level: I support offering a staged carveout for Nimbus given strategic fit and multi-region requirements, but the proposed Year 1 depth (40% off published Tier 1) exceeds our commercial guardrails for AE approval. This needs VP/CFO authorization because:
- The blended rate would be below our modeled floor for reserved capacity at expected utilization
- Waiving packaging surcharge for 12 months reduces near-term cash recovery and increases payback period

Ask for the approval packet:
1) One-page exception memo explaining strategic rationale and commercial cadence (Rafael)
2) Commercial summary workbook with modeled revenue, gross margin, and payback (Rafael/Marcus)
3) Suggested fallback: limit waiver to Q1 only or add a performance clawback if utilization < 40% after 6 months

I'm attaching a light commercial_summary.xlsx template for finance that Rafael/Marcus should populate.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: commercial_summary.xlsx
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — strategic 3yr commitment (rate card request)

Team —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick finance perspective: the proposed Year 1 blended rate at 60% Tier 1 would create a sub-threshold gross margin if applied to the expected token volume in the model Marissa referenced. I'm open to carveouts for strategic accounts, but we need: a formal exception memo, proposed clawback language, and a clear ramp schedule tied to usage.

Action items for Rafael: please prepare a one-page exception memo (PDF) that includes:
- Deal summary (term, committed tokens, expected ARR)
- Commercial shape by year and modeled gross margin impact
- Recommended fallback/clawback triggers (usage % or revenue thresholds)
- Proposed route (Dedicated vs Hosted) and why routing/packaging concessions are required

Loop in Legal (Vanessa) to confirm whether we can accommodate the packaging waiver mechanically in our SOW and draft a short rider. If Legal flags regulatory concerns for multi-region hosting, note them explicitly.

I will review the memo and run it for CFO signoff if the margin impact is within an acceptable range with clawbacks.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Finance & FP&A
Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Exception memo & commercial package for NimbusHealth — ready for VP/CFO review

Markus / Marissa / Vanessa —

Per your requests, attached is the exception memo (PDF) and a populated commercial_summary workbook. I also included a short SOW draft showing how we would apply the 12-month packaging waiver as a contract rider and the proposed clawback language (6-month utilization gate with pro-rated true-up).

Summary (one paragraph):
NimbusHealth proposes a 36-month contract with a three-year reserved commit that starts at 75% of their pilot consumption and scales to target volume by month 7. We propose the following compressed commercial shape to win the strategic account: Year 1 blended = 60% Tier 1; Year 2 = 70% Tier 1; Year 3 = 75% Tier 1; 12-month packaging waiver with 6-month utilization clawback (if utilization < 40% in first 6 months, revert to standard packaging surcharge and true-up to published Tier 1). Expected ARR at full ramp: $4.2M; modeled Year 1 gross margin: 28% (without further quantization / batching optimizations).

Attachments in thread: exception_memo.pdf, commercial_summary.xlsx, nimbus_sow_draft.docx

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/embedded/abcdef
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345 (NIM-2026-09)

Please reply with explicit VP/CFO signoff or request for changes. If Markus approves, I'll route the SOW for signature.

Thanks,

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
